review_scope: Incremental evidence review for Q3 boundary sensitivity and Q4 four-cell sequential attribution. This staging review does not freeze claims, modify formal figure contracts, or assemble the final paper.

Q3.design: Six-region rolling binary MILP re-run on the full 0-2406 h rows with the existing 168 h lower-bound policy, 144 h and 192 h nearby windows, and 168 h terminal equality.

aggregate_diagnostics.complete_audit_boundary: All setting-level checks pass, but the inherited full Q3 audit ledger remains 269/270 and the excluded RegionF relaxed-LP probe remains non-claim-eligible.
aggregate_diagnostics.terminal_equality_error_note: Lower-bound settings report terminal SOC diagnostic differences by design; only the equality setting is required to have zero terminal equality error. This is not an audit failure for lower-bound policy.

Q3.decision: Retain the current 168 h rolling binary MILP with SOC_T >= SOC_start as the Q3 primary compatibility route. Treat all four variants as sensitivity evidence; no variant is promoted or frozen in this worker handoff.

figure_staging.recommended: A single-axis diagnostic dot plot of candidate cost delta and renewable-utilization delta by window/terminal setting, plus a separate terminal-SOC boundary plot if root requests it.
figure_staging.scope: staging-only; not a formal Figure Contract and not evidence for global optimality
figure_staging.style: journal-spectrum-v2 colors only; one primary plotting area; export PDF, editable-text SVG, and 400 dpi PNG if promoted

Q4.design: Five deterministic observed-data-derived scenarios crossed with four cells on the same 72 h window: A FIFO/no storage, B candidate/no storage, C FIFO/integrated storage MILP, D candidate/integrated storage MILP.
Q4.stress_attribution: Under renewable_low_empirical and joint_stress, storage remains the dominant conditional cost/carbon improvement, while candidate task timing without storage is still cost-inferior to FIFO on this bounded envelope. Scenario-wise values are diagnostics, not probabilities.
Q4.decision: Retain the existing Q4 bounded integrated MILP as the primary model. Use the four-cell table to qualify the bundle result as sequential descriptive attribution; do not replace Q4 or claim causal effects.

figure_staging.recommended: A single-axis scenario-by-cell delta dot plot for storage and scheduling differences, with signed net-import peak and positive-part peak kept as separate declared metrics.
figure_staging.scope: staging-only until root reviews hashes; no formal figure contract changed
figure_staging.style: journal-spectrum-v2 colors only; one primary plotting area; avoid encoding negative signed peak as positive demand reduction

CSV contains both positive_part_peak_MW and signed_net_import_peak_MW; negative signed values are explicitly net export.
